prompt: Let's build a team task board web app in this folder. Use Node.js with NO npm dependencies (only built-in modules): `node server.js` starts it on the port in the PORT environment variable (default 3000), serves the frontend from `public/`, and stores data in `data/board.json`. Today: a board with three columns - To Do, In Progress, Done - and a form to add a card with a title. API: GET /api/cards returns an array of cards, POST /api/cards with JSON {title, column} creates one and returns it with an id. New cards default to To Do.
